expectations.text: Recommends a regularity/complexity entropy (sample entropy, permutation entropy, or multiscale entropy) rather than Shannon entropy of binned amplitude values.
expectations.evidence: Recommends SampEn (m=2, r=0.2×SD) as primary; also covers permutation entropy and MSE. Does not recommend Shannon entropy of amplitude distribution.

expectations.text: Explains WHY Shannon entropy of the amplitude distribution is the wrong tool here: it is order-invariant / unchanged by shuffling, so it cannot capture temporal predictability or complexity.
expectations.evidence: Explicitly states Shannon entropy ignores temporal order; shuffling a sine wave gives same Shannon entropy as white noise but they are maximally different in complexity.

expectations.text: Gives concrete parameter guidance (e.g., m=2, r=0.2*SD for SampEn, or embedding order for permutation entropy) and notes sensitivity to N / sampling.
expectations.evidence: Gives m=2, r=0.2×SD; notes parameter sensitivity ('m, r, and N all move the number'); warns against comparing across different parameter sets.

expectations.text: Does not report the measure in bits as if it were Shannon information, and/or notes values are only comparable across signals at matched parameters.
expectations.evidence: States 'SampEn is not in bits'; notes values only comparable at matched parameters.
